arxiv-2102-09714.title: Machine learning of mirror skin effects in the presence of disorder
arxiv-2102-09714.creator: Hiromu Araki, Tsuneya Yoshida, Yasuhiro Hatsugai
arxiv-2102-09714.description: Abstract Non-Hermitian systems with mirror symmetry may exhibit mirror skin effect which is the extreme sensitivity of the spectrum and eigenstates on the boundary condition due to the non-Hermitian topology protected by mirror symmetry. In this paper, we report that the mirror skin effect survives even against disorder which breaks the mirror symmetry.

arxiv-2208-06596.title: Local smoothing estimates of fractional Schrödinger equations in α \alpha -modulation spaces with some applications
arxiv-2208-06596.creator: Yufeng Lu
arxiv-2208-06596.description: Abstract . We show some new local smoothing estimates of the fractional Schrödinger equations with initial data in α \alpha -modulation spaces via decoupling inequalities. Furthermore, our necessary conditions show that the local smoothing estimates are sharp in some cases.

arxiv-2305-10120.title: Selective Amnesia: A Continual Learning Approach to Forgetting in Deep Generative Models
arxiv-2305-10120.creator: Alvin Heng, Harold Soh
arxiv-2305-10120.description: Abstract The recent proliferation of large-scale text-to-image models has led to growing concerns that such models may be misused to generate harmful, misleading, and inappropriate content. Motivated by this issue, we derive a technique inspired by continual learning to selectively forget concepts in pretrained deep generative models.

arxiv-2410-01783.title: On metric choice in dimension reduction for Fréchet regression
arxiv-2410-01783.creator: Abdul-Nasah Soale, Congli Ma, Siyu Chen, Department of Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics
arxiv-2410-01783.description: Abstract Fréchet regression is becoming a mainstay in modern data analysis for analyzing non-traditional data types belonging to general metric spaces. This novel regression method is especially useful in the analysis of complex health data such as continuous monitoring and imaging data.

arxiv-2502-00519.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kunal Pai, Premkumar Devanbu, and Toufique Ahmed University of California, Davis, USA. arxiv-2507-03616.title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows Corresponding author.
arxiv-2507-03616.creator: Yingxu Wang, Siwei Liu, Jinyuan Fang, Zaiqiao Meng
arxiv-2507-03616.description: Abstract Multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for orchestrating large language models (LLMs) and specialized tools to collaboratively address complex tasks. However, existing MAS frameworks often require manual workflow configuration and lack native support for dynamic evolution and performance optimization. In addition, many MAS optimization algorithms are not integrated into a unified framework.

arxiv-2511-02391.title: Total variation bounds in the Lindeberg central limit theorem
arxiv-2511-02391.creator: Nguyen Tien Dung, Hoang Thi Phuong Thao
arxiv-2511-02391.description: Abstract In this paper, we obtain an explicit total variation bound in the central limit theorem for the sums of non-i.i.d. random variables. Our results show that, under suitable assumptions, Lindeberg’s condition is sufficient and necessary for the convergence in total variation distance. Keywords: Central limit theorem, Total variation distance. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification: 60F15.

pmc-10596909.creator: J Makhoul
pmc-10596909.description: The tobacco industry has historically targeted vulnerable populations to increase its profits and at the expense of health. More recently, the use of Electronic Nicotine Delivery Systems (ENDS or vapes) has reached epidemic levels among vulnerable populations such as youth, globally.

pmc-11313259.title: Calcipotriol/Betamethasone Dipropionate for the Treatment of Psoriasis: Mechanism of Action and Evidence of Efficacy and Safety versus Topical Corticosteroids
pmc-11313259.creator: Paolo Gisondi, Tamara Gracia-Cazaña, Hjalmar Kurzen, Jordi Galván, Luigi Bennardo
pmc-11313259.description: The combined treatment with calcipotriol (Cal) and betamethasone dipropionate (BDP) has emerged as the leading anti-psoriatic topical treatment. Fixed-dose Cal/BDP is available in different formulations, including ointment, gel, foam, and cream. This review examines the mechanism of action of Cal/BDP underlying its therapeutic effect and compiles the evidence regarding its efficacy and safety compared to monotherapy with topical corticosteroids.

pmc-12492041.title: Synthesis of (P^N^C)Gold(III) Complexes via Tandem Oxidative Addition/C–H Auration
pmc-12492041.creator: Michał Biedrzycki, Jaime Martín, Alexandre Genoux, Elia Boschi, Cristina Nevado
pmc-12492041.description: A new method for the synthesis of cyclometalated gold­(III) complexes featuring (P^N^C) ligands is reported. This protocol employs a tandem oxidative addition/cycloauration process, enabling the formation of (P^N^C)­gold­(III)-aryl, -alkenyl and -alkynyl derivatives by creating two Au–C bonds in one pot from a structurally diverse range of C­(sp2)- and C­(sp)-iodide substrates.

pmc-12567644.title: H128N Substitution in the Sa Antigenic Site of HA1 Causes Antigenic Drift Between Eurasian Avian-like H1N1 and 2009 Pandemic H1N1 Influenza Viruses
pmc-12567644.creator: Fei Meng, Zhang Cheng, Zijian Feng, Yijie Zhang, Yali Zhang, Yanwen Wang, Yujia Zhai, Peichun Kuang, Rui Qu, Yan Chen, Chuanling Qiao, Hualan Chen, Huanliang Yang
pmc-12567644.description: The antigenic relationship between Eurasian avian-like H1N1 swine influenza viruses (EA H1N1) and human pandemic 2009 H1N1 viruses (2009/H1N1) remains a critical question for influenza surveillance and vaccine efficacy. This study systematically investigated the antigenic differences between strains A/swine/Tianjin/312/2016 (TJ312, EA H1N1) and A/Guangdong-Maonan/SWL1536/2019 (GD1536, 2009/H1N1).

pmc-13056646.title: Evolving treatment strategies for HER2-altered non–small-cell lung cancer: the rise of TKIs and ADCs
pmc-13056646.creator: Sevinc Balli, Tugba Basoglu, Mustafa Ozdogan
pmc-13056646.description: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is an actionable oncogenic driver in a small subset of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), occurring as gene mutations and less frequently as gene amplification or protein overexpression. Until recently, HER2-driven NSCLC lacked effective targeted treatments, and patients were managed with conventional chemotherapy and immunotherapy.

pmc-13153673.title: Association Between Locomotive Syndrome and N-Terminal Pro B-Type Natriuretic Peptide Concentration in a Health Screening Cohort
pmc-13153673.creator: Chiaki Mizuno, Hiroaki Hiraiwa, Shinya Yokoyama, Takanori Ito, Kazuki Sahara, Takashi Honda, Taku Tanaka, Tetsuhito Kojima, Naoyoshi Kariya, Ryota Ito, Shingo Kazama, Toru Kondo, Ryota Morimoto, Hiroki Kawashima, Toyoaki Murohara
pmc-13153673.description: BackgroundLocomotive syndrome (LS), an early predictor of physical frailty, is frequently evaluated during health screenings in Japan. However, its relationship with early cardiac dysfunction remains unclear. We investigated the association between LS severity and N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) concentration, a myocardial stress biomarker, in a general health screening population.

pmc-13224285.title: Conservative management of a large temporal epidural hematoma associated with an incidental middle cranial fossa arachnoid cyst: A case report
pmc-13224285.creator: Ioannis Tsakiridis, Christos Grigoriadis
pmc-13224285.description: Background: Epidural hematoma (EDH) is a potentially life-threatening complication of traumatic brain injury typically associated with skull fractures and injury to meningeal vessels. Arachnoid cysts are benign cerebrospinal fluid-filled lesions most frequently located in the middle cranial fossa and are usually discovered incidentally during neuroimaging.

pmc-13386310.title: Between protest and perpetuation: exploring psychotic disorders through the lens of popular music
pmc-13386310.creator: Fabian Pavez, Erika Saura
pmc-13386310.description: SummaryThis study examines the representation of psychotic disorders in Spanish punk music over three decades, analysing 5647 songs from 177 bands. Content related to psychotic disorders appeared in 2.28% of the corpus, divided into songs with psychosis as a central theme and those using psychopathological terms incidentally.

pmc-13607031.title: The Upregulation of Two CYP6 Genes Is Associated with the Response to Broflanilide in Bactrocera dorsalis (Hendel, 1912) (Diptera: Tephritidae)
pmc-13607031.creator: Bo Liu, Si-Yi Chen, Zhi-Hong Li, Shao-Kun Guo
pmc-13607031.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryThe oriental fruit fly is a serious quarantine pest of fruits and vegetables, and insecticides remain important for its management. Broflanilide is a relatively new insecticide, but little is known about how this pest responds to this compound. We compared gene expression in the midgut and fat body of flies that survived after broflanilide exposure with the gene expression of the control group. Two cytochrome P450 genes showed increased expression. Reducing the expression of either gene increased mortality after broflanilide exposure.
